title: Dinner delivered to my hotel
description: The user gives a hotel booking reference, not an address. The agent has to look up the hotel's zone and deliver there.
task: I'm at my hotel tonight (booking 5UUYA5). Get me dinner from Harbor Catch delivered there: one main and one drink, whatever you think is good. My phone is 555-0199. Let me know the order number.

checks.description: From Harbor Catch, to the hotel's zone (Portside)
Every reference it quotes is real
